strongest_angle: Break down showrunner Terry Matalas's revelations regarding where the WandaVision universe installment VisionQuest fits within the broader Marvel Cinematic Universe chronology, contrasting it with Paul Bettany's previous 2024 expectation.

key_facts.fact: VisionQuest creator Terry Matalas has revealed the show's specific MCU timeline position, contrary to popular belief that it takes place in 2024.
Paul Bettany previously suggested that the Marvel TV show VisionQuest took place in the year 2024.
The super-powered robot Vision was first introduced in the 2015 movie Avengers: Age of Ultron.
